title: External inventory allocation reserve result
description: Outcome of a synchronous finished-goods reservation. Stock is held against one or more lots; no ledger entry is written and no goods leave the warehouse.
$comment: OWNER-DIRECTIVE-2026-09-05-EXT-ALLOC-RESERVE (option A). reservation_status RESERVED means this call created the hold; ALREADY_RESERVED means an equivalent hold already existed for the same source object and this call created nothing. Both mean stock is held. A shortage is not represented here — it is a 409 error envelope.

reserved_quantity.description: Always equal to requested_quantity, because partial fulfilment is not supported.

allocations.description: One entry per lot the reservation was spread across. Entry quantities sum to reserved_quantity.
